units.source_text: 大女公子每到夜间，病势必沉重些。

en.t: The elder princess's illness always grew more serious at night.

units.source_text: 今夜有个陌生客人坐在近旁，二女公子替姐姐担心。

en.t: That night an unfamiliar visitor was sitting close by, and the second princess worried about her elder sister.

units.source_text: 侍女们便去对中纳言说：“还请依照向例，到那边请坐。”

en.t: The gentlewomen therefore went to the middle counselor and said, "Please do as usual and take your seat over there."

units.source_text: 中纳言答道：“今天我是挂念大小姐病状，不顾一切特地来探望的。

en.t: The middle counselor replied, "Today I was so anxious about the elder young lady's condition that I came specially to visit her, heedless of everything else.

units.source_text: 你们赶我出去，太不讲情理了。

en.t: For you to drive me out is far too unreasonable.

units.source_text: 试问除我而外，谁能诚心诚意地远来问病呢？”

en.t: Tell me, apart from me, who would come all this way in true sincerity to ask after her illness?"

units.source_text: 他就出去和老侍女弁君商谈，吩咐她开始举办祈祷。

en.t: He then went out, consulted with the old gentlewoman Ben no Kimi, and instructed her to begin arranging prayers.

units.source_text: 大女公子闻之颇感不快，自念此身早已情愿死去，又何必祈祷。

en.t: When the elder princess heard this, she felt quite displeased, thinking that she had long been ready to die and that prayers were unnecessary.

units.source_text: 又念辜负美意而断然拒绝，亦太乏味。

en.t: Yet she also thought that to reject his kindness outright would be too cold and ungracious.

units.source_text: 她毕竟希望长命，此心亦甚可怜。

en.t: After all, she did wish to live longer, and that feeling too was deeply pitiable.

units.source_text: 次日，薰中纳言说：“今天小姐病状好些了吧？

en.t: The next day, Kaoru, the middle counselor, said, "Is the young lady's condition somewhat better today?

units.source_text: 但愿能同昨天一样和我晤谈。”

en.t: I hope she may speak with me as she did yesterday."

units.source_text: 侍女便向大女公子传言。

en.t: The gentlewoman conveyed his message to the elder princess.

units.source_text: 大女公子说：“我连日患病，今天甚觉痛苦。

en.t: The elder princess said, "I have been ill for days, and today I feel great pain.

units.source_text: 中纳言既然如此要求，就请他进来吧。”

en.t: Since the middle counselor asks so earnestly, please let him come in."

units.source_text: 薰中纳言不知大女公子的病究竟吉凶如何，心中十分悲伤。

en.t: Kaoru, the middle counselor, did not know whether the elder princess's illness would turn for good or ill, and his heart was filled with sorrow.

units.source_text: 看见她今天态度比往常亲切，反而焦灼不安起来。

en.t: Seeing that her manner today was kinder than usual, he became even more anxious and uneasy.

units.source_text: 便靠近病床，对她谈了许多话。

en.t: He drew near her sickbed and spoke many words to her.

units.source_text: 大女公子说：“我痛苦不能作答，且待病势稍减时再谈。”

en.t: The elder princess said, "I am in too much pain to answer. Let us speak again when my illness has eased a little."

units.source_text: 她的声音非常微弱而悲哀，薰中纳言觉得无限伤心，悲叹不已。

en.t: Her voice was extremely faint and sorrowful, and Kaoru, the middle counselor, felt boundless grief and could not cease lamenting.

units.source_text: 但他终不能徒然地滞留在此，虽然非常担心，也只得准备回京。

en.t: Yet he could not linger there to no purpose forever, and though he was terribly worried, he had no choice but to prepare to return to the capital.

units.source_text: 临行他说：“这等地方毕竟不可久居。

en.t: As he was leaving, he said, "In the end, one cannot live long in such a place.

units.source_text: 还不如以迁地疗养为由，移居适当的处所吧。”

en.t: It would be better to use a change of place for recuperation as the reason and move to a more suitable residence."

units.source_text: 又叮嘱阿阇梨尽心祈祷，然后告别回京。

en.t: He also urged the acharya to devote himself fully to the prayers, then took his leave and returned to the capital.
